declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationMinimum.minimumEvent
declarations.assessment: Arbitrary independent index/priority universes, LE only; event retains member a and every comparison under the same sampled permutation.

declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationMinimum.mem_minimumEvent
declarations.assessment: Exact membership iff; no measurability, finiteness, order-law or default-index premise.

declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationMinimum.minimumEvent_empty
declarations.assessment: Empty subset event is empty for any LE priority operation.

declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationMinimum.minimumEvent_of_not_mem
declarations.assessment: Outside-member premise makes the event empty; no comparison-only substitution.

declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationMinimum.minimumEvent_singleton
declarations.assessment: Preorder reflexivity makes the sole singleton member a minimum on every sample.

declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationMinimum.minimumEvent_inter
declarations.assessment: Intersection of the same member minimum in two subsets equals its minimum on their union; both membership hypotheses and DecidableEq for union remain.

declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationMinimum.uniformOn_minimumEvent
declarations.assessment: Finite I and independently universe-polymorphic LinearOrder P; explicit permutation measurability/singletons, injective priority and a in S yield ENNReal inverse cardinality. No order/measurable structure on I, finite target, Nonempty I or public Fintype premise.

declarations.name: Examples.PermutationMinimum.overlap_mass
